title: Uncertainty Performance Domain
coreMove: Manage uncertainty as a live domain: use the risk register, ambiguity signals, probes, reserves, and escalations to adjust the whole project system around value.

exampleSpecs.domain: Mariana writes a decision memo after a steering vote
exampleSpecs.audience: project leads who treat risk work as separate from domain performance
exampleSpecs.stakes: a documented risk looks controlled while other PMBOK Guide domains are shifting
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mariana uses the memo to connect the Uncertainty Performance Domain, 8 domains, and risk register before the next steering update

exampleSpecs.domain: Rosa and Jack respond to the same supplier delay
exampleSpecs.audience: teams deciding whether a register update is enough
exampleSpecs.stakes: one project records uncertainty while the other changes behavior
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Rosa and Jack face the same risk register, ambiguity, complexity, and volatility signals with opposite responses

exampleSpecs.domain: Nikolai gets coached by Mabel after a tidy risk review
exampleSpecs.audience: analysts who confuse scored risk with managed uncertainty
exampleSpecs.stakes: a clean review may hide ambiguity, complexity, and volatility
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mabel gives Nikolai a quotable reframe that separates risk register work from ambiguity probes

exampleSpecs.domain: Aditya learns the domain map in a training session
exampleSpecs.audience: learners who expect PMBOK Guide domains to act like sequence steps
exampleSpecs.stakes: the learner may memorize labels without understanding interaction
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Aditya works through the PMBOK Guide's 8 domains and sees why the Uncertainty Performance Domain is not a risk register phase

exampleSpecs.domain: Seraphine revises uncertainty intake for a hybrid project
exampleSpecs.audience: process owners who turn every unknown into the same artifact
exampleSpecs.stakes: the process may score uncertainty instead of selecting the right response
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Seraphine shows the same intake before and after it distinguishes threats, opportunities, ambiguity, complexity, and volatility

exampleSpecs.domain: Mabel audits existing project records for uncertainty signals
exampleSpecs.audience: leaders reviewing artifacts after a project review feels strangely calm
exampleSpecs.stakes: the records may show activity while the uncertainty outcome stays weak
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mabel reviews records and finds the telling detail in risk register rows, ambiguity notes, complexity notes, and volatility patterns
